complexity.notes: Correct and clear. Since each entry only reads the next two, the array could be replaced by two rolling variables for O(1) space, but the time complexity is already optimal.
complexity.summary: Bottom-up DP from the end: a[i] is the minimum cost to reach the top starting from step i, computed as cost[i] plus the cheaper of the next two entries; the answer is min(a[0], a[1]).
